senses.gloss: [to destroy,] to persecute; to force to apostasy.
units: Gen. R. s. 82 ואם לאו הרי אני מְשַׁמֵּד אתכם and if you cannot answer, I will force you to forswear your religion; Yalk. Is. 263 אַשְׁמִיד (Hif.).—Part. pass. מְשׁוּמָּד converted to heathenism, q. v.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:10">Esth. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>אני אמרתי להַשְׁמִידָם</he> … <he>להַשְׁמִיד וכ׳</he> I (the Lord) intended to destroy them, and, as it were, could not …, and thou wilt destroy, slay &c.? <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:12">Ib. to III, 12</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 558">Yalk. Lev. 558</cite> <he>דואג נ׳ מעולם וכ׳</he> Doeg was cut off from this and from the other world; (Tanḥ. M’tsorʿa 2 <cite ref="U02038"><he>נשתרש</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to apostatize. Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48ᶜ. Y. Hor. I, 45ᵈ bot. Y. Succ. V, end, 55ᶜ מרים … שׁנִשְׁתַּמְּדָה וכ׳ Miriam … who renounced her religion, and married a Roman officer; Tosef. Succ. IV, 28ᵈ; Bab.
